news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Interest payments are not well covered by earnings (2.2x net interest cover). Minor Risks Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (6.9% average weekly change). Large one-off items

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹1.42 (vs ₹1.22 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹1.42 (up from ₹1.22 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹520.2m (up 46% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹19.8m (up 19% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.8% (down from 4.7% in 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 42% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 7% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.

news.title: Calcom Vision Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 22.499981 million in funding from 238 Plan Associates LLC, Old Bridge Capital Management Private Limited, Massachusetts Institute of Technology and other investors
news.body: Calcom Vision Limited announced a private placement to issue 789,473 warrants at an issue price of INR 28.5 per warrant for gross proceeds of INR 22,499,980.5 on November 15, 2025. The transaction will include participation from new investors and returning investors Sushil Kumar Malik 141,662 warrants, Abhishek Malik 566,648 warrants, Massachusetts Institute of Technology 51,709 warrants, Micro Strategies Fund 23,709 warrants and 238 Plan Associates LLC 5,745 warrants. The transaction has been approved by shareholders of company.
